title: Complete story-linked ad hoc sessions in the Dashboard

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage

**Caught.** At `6309fcc44aa999fc4135e45640480d91b8a56281`, the maintained Dashboard backend test caught an installed Automatically land handoff reaching the wrong Codex conversation. This checks the blank Start and retained landing policy in `SEED-439#complete-story-linked-ad-hoc-sessions` and obligation G6 in plan 833. The result covers the exercised Codex default-checkout path.

The single scratch fault removed the session-ID comparison from the persisted record filter in `Distribution/src/skills/dough-execute-plan/scripts/session-landing-handoff.mjs:55`. The fixture installed the current Distribution source in its temporary Git project and used the Codex protocol fixture. The same command selected one case for baseline, fault and restoration.

```sh
caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard:backend -- dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-start-session-landing-policy.spec.ts --grep 'a blank Start hands Automatically land to its native conversation alone' --workers=1 --reporter=list
```

The baseline passed. With the fault, the matching check still returned the expected policy, story and reporting context. The assertion `expect(handoff("other-conversation")).toBe("")` at `dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-start-session-landing-policy.spec.ts:70` failed because the other conversation received the established session, Taken story, landing context and Dashboard reporting block. In a separate synthetic Git project with one settled launch, the installed script returned byte-identical handoffs for matching and different conversation IDs under the fault. Baseline and restored runs returned the handoff for the matching ID and empty output for the different ID.

The restored test passed. The source bytes, HEAD and workspace status matched the pre-probe state, and the scratch worktree was removed.

**Next proof action.** Retain the existing wrong-conversation assertion. No additional proof is indicated for this path. The result confirms G6’s existing disposition.

- **Test runtime.** Playwright reported 4.7 s for the baseline case, 3.7 s for the faulted case and 4.0 s for the restored case. The baseline and restored runner totals were 12.4 s and 5.8 s. All are measured runner values.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No human operation was observed or timed during the probe.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. Active agent effort was recorded only as part of the invocation-to-report elapsed time.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 163199 ms (measured), from 1795673220000 to 1795673383199 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision `6309fcc44aa999fc4135e45640480d91b8a56281`. Verdict **Caught**. Retain the maintained wrong-conversation assertion. No follow-up for the exercised path.
